title: Cream of Chickpea Soup with Toasted Rosemary Pita

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Place half in a small bowl and set aside.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies, remaining garlic, and spices to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; transfer to a blender, along with broth, and blend until smooth.
Add chickpea mixture, additional broth, and zucchini to the pot, stir to combine, and bring soup to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high.
Place pitas on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with reserved garlic, salt, and rosemary. Place in the oven and broil until golden and toasted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Divide soup between bowls and drizzle with oil. Serve with pita on the side and enjoy!
